About

I bring a distinctive blend of analytical rigor and hands-on leadership to building. I started my career as a corporate paralegal at Cravath, Swaine & Moore LLP in New York—an experience that sharpened my attention to detail and my ability to manage complex, high-stakes projects. In the fall of 2006, I joined Jon Luce Builder, where I worked as a Project Manager and learned under the best there is: my father.

A proud graduate of the University of Virginia, I earned a Bachelor of Science in Foreign Affairs and International Relations before completing a Master of Education in Social Foundations and Policy.

After nearly two decades alongside my father, I launched Jeremy Luce Builder to continue that legacy of excellence and craftsmanship.

  • Born and raised in Austin
  • Former Team Captain of the University of Virginia Cavalier golf team and a four-year letterman, 2000–2004
  • After a brief attempt to compete as a professional, I decided to transition to a more normal career path

The Craftsmen

I don’t build alone. A home is only as good as the hands that shape it, and over the years I’ve come to rely on a close circle of craftspeople—metalworkers, woodworkers, and fabricators—who bring the drawings to life with a care you can feel.

Services

Jeremy Luce Builder is a custom home builder based in Austin, Texas, working hand in hand with homeowners and architects from the first sketch to the final walkthrough. Our work is organized into four core services—each backed by the same analytical rigor, hands-on craftsmanship, and standard of finish that holds up for decades.

New Construction

Ground-up custom homes built to the architect’s drawings and the owner’s standard. We run the project from foundation to final detail—coordinating every trade, holding the schedule, and keeping the quality bar high so the finished home lives up to the vision.

Renovations & Additions

Thoughtful remodels, additions, and whole-home updates that respect the character of what’s already there. We plan around how you actually live, protect the parts of the house you love, and leave it better than we found it.

Preconstruction & Budgeting

Honest estimating, value engineering, and scheduling before a single wall goes up. You get a clear-eyed budget and timeline early, so there are no surprises once ground breaks.

Design-Build Collaboration

A true partner alongside your architect and designers, translating drawings into buildable, beautiful work. We flag issues early, offer options instead of obstacles, and keep everyone moving toward the same result.

Have a project in mind? Let’s talk through what you’re building.
